description: Implementation of reduction operations for torch objects, including functions like sum, mean, std, var, argmax, argmin, min, max, and others, often decorated to handle axis arguments and specific dtype handling. These functions are part of the '_reductions_impl.py' module within the torch/_numpy directory, providing reduction operations similar to NumPy for torch objects.
